name: Bruggner Stub'n
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Bruggner Stub'n in Tirol!**

Nestled in the heart of the **Alps**, this cozy mountain inn invites you to experience authentic **Tirol** hospitality. Whether you're craving hearty **Kaiserschmarrn**, savory **Tiroler Gröstl**, or a steaming bowl of **Käsespätzle**, our rustic dishes will warm your soul.

After a day of hiking through breathtaking landscapes, relax by the crackling fireplace with a glass of crisp **Tiroler Bier** or a smooth **Apfelstrudel** for dessert. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, Bruggner Stub'n is the perfect retreat for nature lovers and food enthusiasts alike.

Come taste the flavors of **Tirol**—where tradition meets mountain charm!
